senses.definition: n.pr.loc. town on southern border of N. Israel, near Bethel, 2 Ch 13:19; so read also 1 S 7:12 for MT הַשֵּׁן We Dr Klo Kit Bu; mod. ʿAin Siniya, 5 m. N. of Beitun, Cl. Ganneau JAs Avr.-Juin, 1870, 490–501 SocinZPV i, 1878, 41 BuhlGeogr. § 95, p. 173.
